links.outcome: Response consistency across repeated runs at different times and days, in English and Chinese
links.effect: Both models showed similar consistency (p = 1.000 English; p = 0.412 Chinese). Time of day and testing day had no effect on performance (p > 0.05). Accuracy was 90.4% for ChatGPT-4o and 88.0% for DeepSeek.
links.quote: Both models demonstrated similar consistency in their responses (p = 1.000 for English; p = 0.412 for Chinese).

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the baseline accuracy, consistency, and response times of ChatGPT-4o and DeepSeek on a set of 50 orthodontic health literacy questions without evaluating a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
